pin.text: Did you know there's a village in Turkey where people talk by whistling?

tourist.text: Wait, what? You people really live out here? Come on, that sounds totally crazy to me.

sardaana.text: Good morning! I am Sardaana, I am nine years old, and I walk to school every day, even when it is very, very cold outside.

nikolai.text: Заходите, заходите, внутри тепло. Здесь, в Оймяконе, мы пьём горячий чай, топим печку и никогда не жалуемся на холод.
